name: internship-tracker
description: Undergraduate-eligible SWE/SDE internship tracker with automated closure verification

scripts.refresh: npm run start -w pipeline && npm run sync -w web
scripts.refresh:fast: npm run start -w pipeline -- --no-verify && npm run sync -w web
scripts.refresh:force: npm run start -w pipeline -- --force && npm run sync -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w pipeline && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w pipeline && npm run typecheck -w web
